// run
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

type ctxKey string

func worker(ctx context.Context, out chan<- string) {
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		out <- "cancelled: " + ctx.Err().Error()
	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
		out <- "timeout in worker"
	}
}

func main() {
	bg := context.Background()
	fmt.Println(bg.Err() == nil, bg.Done() == nil, bg.Value("x") == nil)
	d, ok := bg.Deadline()
	fmt.Println(d.IsZero(), ok)

	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(bg)
	out := make(chan string, 1)
	go worker(ctx, out)
	cancel()
	fmt.Println(<-out)
	fmt.Println(ctx.Err() == context.Canceled)
	cancel()
	fmt.Println(ctx.Err() == context.Canceled)

	tctx, tcancel := context.WithTimeout(bg, 5*time.Millisecond)
	defer tcancel()
	<-tctx.Done()
	fmt.Println(tctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded, tctx.Err())
	_, hasDL := tctx.Deadline()
	fmt.Println("has deadline:", hasDL)

	vctx := context.WithValue(bg, ctxKey("user"), "ada")
	child := context.WithValue(vctx, ctxKey("id"), 7)
	fmt.Println(child.Value(ctxKey("user")), child.Value(ctxKey("id")), child.Value(ctxKey("missing")))

	parent, pcancel := context.WithCancel(bg)
	kid, kcancel := context.WithCancel(parent)
	defer kcancel()
	pcancel()
	<-kid.Done()
	fmt.Println("child cancelled with parent:", kid.Err() == context.Canceled)
}

// run
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	base := context.Background()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(30 * time.Millisecond)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithDeadline(base, deadline)
	defer cancel()
	d, ok := ctx.Deadline()
	fmt.Println("deadline set:", ok, !d.Before(deadline) && !d.After(deadline))
	fmt.Println("not yet expired:", ctx.Err() == nil)
	<-ctx.Done()
	fmt.Println("expired:", ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded, ctx.Err())

	// a deadline already in the past fires immediately
	past, cancel2 := context.WithDeadline(base, time.Now().Add(-time.Second))
	defer cancel2()
	<-past.Done()
	fmt.Println("past deadline:", past.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded)

	// a child deadline never outlives the parent's
	outer, cancel3 := context.WithTimeout(base, 20*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel3()
	inner, cancel4 := context.WithDeadline(outer, time.Now().Add(10*time.Second))
	defer cancel4()
	id, _ := inner.Deadline()
	od, _ := outer.Deadline()
	fmt.Println("child clamped to parent:", !id.After(od))
	<-inner.Done()
	fmt.Println("child cancelled with parent:", inner.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded)

	// cancelling explicitly beats the deadline
	ctx5, cancel5 := context.WithDeadline(base, time.Now().Add(time.Hour))
	cancel5()
	<-ctx5.Done()
	fmt.Println("explicit cancel:", ctx5.Err() == context.Canceled)
}

// run
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(50 * time.Millisecond)
	fmt.Println("Until is positive before the deadline:", time.Until(deadline) > 0)
	fmt.Println("Until is negative after it:", time.Until(time.Now().Add(-time.Second)) < 0)
	t0 := time.Now()
	time.Sleep(8 * time.Millisecond)
	t1 := time.Now()
	d := t1.Sub(t0)
	fmt.Println("elapsed at least 8ms:", d >= 8*time.Millisecond)
	fmt.Println("since agrees:", time.Since(t0) >= d)
	fmt.Println("ordering:", t0.Before(t1), t1.After(t0), t0.Equal(t0))

	// Round(0) strips the monotonic reading; arithmetic then uses the wall clock.
	w0 := t0.Round(0)
	w1 := t1.Round(0)
	fmt.Println("wall difference is still positive:", w1.Sub(w0) > 0)
	fmt.Println("wall ordering:", w0.Before(w1))

	// Adding a duration shifts both readings.
	t2 := t0.Add(50 * time.Millisecond)
	fmt.Println("add:", t2.Sub(t0) == 50*time.Millisecond, t2.After(t0))

	// Truncate also strips it and rounds the wall clock down.
	tr := t1.Truncate(time.Second)
	fmt.Println("truncated to a whole second:", tr.UnixNano()%int64(time.Second) == 0)

	fmt.Println("durations:", (1500 * time.Millisecond).Round(time.Second),
		(1400 * time.Millisecond).Round(time.Second),
		(1900 * time.Millisecond).Truncate(time.Second))
	var zero time.Time
	fmt.Println("zero:", zero.IsZero(), zero.Equal(time.Time{}))
}

// run
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"sync"
)

func main() {
	var m sync.Map
	v, ok := m.Load("absent")
	fmt.Println(v, ok)
	m.Store("a", 1)
	m.Store("b", 2)
	v, ok = m.Load("a")
	fmt.Println(v, ok)
	actual, loaded := m.LoadOrStore("a", 99)
	fmt.Println(actual, loaded)
	actual, loaded = m.LoadOrStore("c", 3)
	fmt.Println(actual, loaded)
	var keys []string
	m.Range(func(k, v interface{}) bool {
		keys = append(keys, fmt.Sprintf("%v=%v", k, v))
		return true
	})
	sort.Strings(keys)
	fmt.Println(keys)
	m.Delete("b")
	_, ok = m.Load("b")
	fmt.Println(ok)
	m.Delete("a")
	n := 0
	m.Range(func(k, v interface{}) bool { n++; return true })
	fmt.Println(n)

	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	var counts sync.Map
	for i := 0; i < 40; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(n int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			counts.Store(n%4, n)
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	total := 0
	counts.Range(func(k, v interface{}) bool { total++; return true })
	fmt.Println("distinct keys:", total)
}

// Test slicing and re-slicing.

package main

var bx []byte
var by []byte
var fx []float64
var fy []float64
var lb, hb int
var t int

func main() {

	// width 1 (byte)
	lb = 0
	hb = 10
	by = bx[lb:hb]
	tstb()
	by = bx[lb:10]
	tstb()
	by = bx[lb:]
	tstb()
	by = bx[:hb]
	tstb()
	by = bx[0:hb]
	tstb()
	by = bx[0:10]
	tstb()
	by = bx[0:]
	tstb()
	by = bx[:10]
	tstb()
	by = bx[:]
	tstb()

	lb = 2
	hb = 10
	by = bx[lb:hb]
	tstb()
	by = bx[lb:10]
	tstb()
	by = bx[lb:]
	tstb()
	by = bx[2:hb]
	tstb()
	by = bx[2:10]
	tstb()
	by = bx[2:]
	tstb()

	lb = 0
	hb = 8
	by = bx[lb:hb]
	tstb()
	by = bx[lb:8]
	tstb()
	by = bx[0:hb]
	tstb()
	by = bx[0:8]
	tstb()
	by = bx[:8]
	tstb()
	by = bx[:hb]
	tstb()

	lb = 2
	hb = 8
	by = bx[lb:hb]
	tstb()
	by = bx[lb:8]
	tstb()
	by = bx[2:hb]
	tstb()
	by = bx[2:8]
	tstb()

	// width 4 (float64)
	lb = 0
	hb = 10
	fy = fx[lb:hb]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[lb:10]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[lb:]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[:hb]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[0:hb]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[0:10]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[0:]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[:10]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[:]
	tstf()

	lb = 2
	hb = 10
	fy = fx[lb:hb]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[lb:10]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[lb:]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[2:hb]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[2:10]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[2:]
	tstf()

	lb = 0
	hb = 8
	fy = fx[lb:hb]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[lb:8]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[:hb]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[0:hb]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[0:8]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[:8]
	tstf()

	lb = 2
	hb = 8
	fy = fx[lb:hb]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[lb:8]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[2:hb]
	tstf()
	fy = fx[2:8]
	tstf()
}

func tstb() {
	t++
	if len(by) != hb-lb {
		println("t=", t, "lb=", lb, "hb=", hb,
			"len=", len(by), "hb-lb=", hb-lb)
		panic("fail")
	}
	if cap(by) != len(bx)-lb {
		println("t=", t, "lb=", lb, "hb=", hb,
			"cap=", cap(by), "len(bx)-lb=", len(bx)-lb)
		panic("fail")
	}
	for i := lb; i < hb; i++ {
		if bx[i] != by[i-lb] {
			println("t=", t, "lb=", lb, "hb=", hb,
				"bx[", i, "]=", bx[i],
				"by[", i-lb, "]=", by[i-lb])
			panic("fail")
		}
	}
	by = nil
}

func tstf() {
	t++
	if len(fy) != hb-lb {
		println("t=", t, "lb=", lb, "hb=", hb,
			"len=", len(fy), "hb-lb=", hb-lb)
		panic("fail")
	}
	if cap(fy) != len(fx)-lb {
		println("t=", t, "lb=", lb, "hb=", hb,
			"cap=", cap(fy), "len(fx)-lb=", len(fx)-lb)
		panic("fail")
	}
	for i := lb; i < hb; i++ {
		if fx[i] != fy[i-lb] {
			println("t=", t, "lb=", lb, "hb=", hb,
				"fx[", i, "]=", fx[i],
				"fy[", i-lb, "]=", fy[i-lb])
			panic("fail")
		}
	}
	fy = nil
}

func init() {
	bx = make([]byte, 10)
	for i := 0; i < len(bx); i++ {
		bx[i] = byte(i + 20)
	}
	by = nil

	fx = make([]float64, 10)
	for i := 0; i < len(fx); i++ {
		fx[i] = float64(i + 20)
	}
	fy = nil
}

// run
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	s := "Hello, World"
	fmt.Println(strings.ToUpper(s), strings.ToLower(s))
	fmt.Println(strings.Contains(s, "World"), strings.HasPrefix(s, "He"), strings.HasSuffix(s, "ld"))
	fmt.Println(strings.Index(s, "o"), strings.LastIndex(s, "o"), strings.Index(s, "zz"))
	fmt.Println(strings.Split("a,b,,c", ","), len(strings.Split("", ",")))
	fmt.Println(strings.Join([]string{"x", "y", "z"}, "-"))
	fmt.Println(strings.Replace("aaaa", "a", "b", 2), strings.Replace("aaaa", "a", "b", -1))
	fmt.Println("["+strings.TrimSpace("  pad \t\n")+"]", strings.Repeat("ab", 3))
	fmt.Println(strings.Fields("  a  b\tc\n"), strings.Count("cheese", "e"))
	fmt.Println(strings.TrimLeft("xxhixx", "x"), strings.TrimRight("xxhixx", "x"), strings.Trim("xxhixx", "x"))
}
